briefdescription.para: Additional module path entries (files or directories) to add to the -L flag.

detaileddescription.para: This allows specifying custom locations for XTC modules beyond the default source set outputs and xtcModule dependencies.

simplesect.para: the configurable file collection for the module path

briefdescription.para: Execution mode for the launcher task.

detaileddescription.para: Default is ATTACHED (forked JVM with inherited I/O).

briefdescription.para: File path pattern for stdout redirection.

detaileddescription.para: Supports timestamp placeholder TIMESTAMP% which expands to yyyyMMddHHmmss format at execution time.
If not set, stdout will be inherited from the parent process (normal fork) or redirected to a default timestamped log file (detached mode).

simplesect.para: the stdout file path pattern property

briefdescription.para: File path pattern for stderr redirection.

detaileddescription.para: Supports timestamp placeholder TIMESTAMP% which expands to yyyyMMddHHmmss format at execution time.
If not set, stderr will be inherited from the parent process (normal fork) or redirected to a default timestamped log file (detached mode).

simplesect.para: the stderr file path pattern property
